verdict.rationale: Working Copy has two built-in AI features that work on the user's own repository data. It suggests commit messages by sending staged diffs to OpenAI, and its conversational Repository Agent can browse, search, read and modify files. missing for 10: explicit documentation of insight or analysis output (e.g. summaries or explanations of repo content), detail on suggestion scope beyond commit messages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
